text:
## Security Principles  
**Zero-Trust Security:**
- No implicit trust (users, devices, networks)
- Continuous authentication and authorization
- Verify every access request
- Assume breach and defend proactively  
**Defense-in-Depth:**
- Multiple layers of security controls
- No single point of failure
- Layered protections (network, system, data, process)  
**Confidentiality-Integrity-Availability (CIA Triad):**
- **Confidentiality:** Data encrypted, access controlled
- **Integrity:** Data cannot be modified without authorization
- **Availability:** Systems accessible when needed

raw_entities.name: Information Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A foundational information security policy establishing three core security principles: Zero-Trust Security (continuous verification with no implicit trust), Defense-in-Depth (multiple layered controls), and the CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability). The policy mandates proactive breach assumption and comprehensive protective measures across network, system, data, and process layers.
context: Zero-Trust Security: No implicit trust (users, devices, networks)
Defense-in-Depth: Multiple layers of security controls

raw_entities.name: Zero-Trust Authentication and Authorization Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all access requests must be subject to continuous authentication and authorization with no implicit trust granted to users, devices, or networks. Every access request must be verified independently.

raw_entities.name: Proactive Breach Defense Obligation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory obligation to assume breach conditions and implement proactive defensive measures. Staff and systems must operate under the assumption that a breach may occur and design controls accordingly.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Layer Security Control Implementation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to implement multiple layers of security controls across network, system, data, and process domains to eliminate single points of failure and ensure defense-in-depth.

raw_entities.name: Data Confidentiality Through Encryption and Access Control
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to protect data confidentiality through encryption and access control mechanisms, ensuring that sensitive data is protected from unauthorized disclosure.

raw_entities.name: Data Integrity Protection Against Unauthorized Modification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to ensure data integrity by preventing unauthorized modification of data. Controls must guarantee that data cannot be altered without proper authorization.
context: Integrity: Data cannot be modified without authorization

raw_entities.name: System Availability Assurance
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to maintain system availability and ensure that critical systems and data remain accessible to authorized users when needed for business operations.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized users, devices, or networks gaining access to systems or data. Addressed through zero-trust security principles requiring continuous authentication and authorization.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: Risk of data confidentiality compromise through unauthorized disclosure or access. Mitigated through encryption, access controls, and defense-in-depth layered protections.

raw_entities.name: Data Integrity Compromise
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized modification or corruption of data. Addressed through integrity controls that prevent data alteration without proper authorization.
context: Data cannot be modified without authorization

raw_entities.name: System Unavailability
raw_entities.description: Risk of systems or data becoming inaccessible when needed for business operations. Mitigated through availability controls and defense-in-depth architecture with no single points of failure.

raw_entities.name: Continuous Authentication and Authorization
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring continuous verification of every access request with no implicit trust. Implements zero-trust security by verifying users, devices, and networks on every access attempt.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Layer Security Control Architecture
raw_entities.description: Operational safeguard implementing defense-in-depth through multiple layers of security controls across network, system, data, and process domains to eliminate single points of failure.

raw_entities.name: Data Encryption
raw_entities.description: Technical control protecting data confidentiality through encryption mechanisms, ensuring that sensitive data is protected from unauthorized disclosure.

raw_entities.name: Access Control Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Operational control limiting access to data and systems based on authorization rules, supporting both confidentiality and integrity objectives.

raw_entities.name: Data Integrity Verification
raw_entities.description: Control mechanism ensuring that data cannot be modified without authorization, protecting data integrity through verification and authorization requirements.
context: Data cannot be modified without authorization
